newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean basis steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean basis steady to firmer.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis values were steady to firmer on Monday amid sentiment that the recent decline in prices could spark a pickup in demand.
South Korean feed millers and crushers were among potential buyers reported to be eyeing nearby shipments of soybeans this week.
Wheat basis values were unchanged in quiet conditions. Business was expected to start gathering pace over the next few weeks as harvesting of this year's hard red winter crop becomes more widespread.
Corn basis levels were little changed.
